label: TP
reason: User-supplied header values ('BenchmarkTest02081') flow directly into the HTML response via Cookie name and value concatenation without any filtering or escaping. The Base64 round-trip in doSomething preserves all characters including '<', '>' and '"'. Since the response writes these values unescaped into HTML context, an attacker can inject arbitrary scripts.

evidence.note: Cookie name/value constructed from user header without HTML entity encoding
